purpose: Validate that third-party platform configuration enforces JPV governance without becoming the source of authority or creating an unsatisfiable execution deadlock.
validation_requirements: verify every blocking platform gate has an operable satisfaction or governed recovery path
reject mandatory review if no eligible reviewer can actually authenticate and approve
reject reliance on GitHub Actions approval unless repository settings permit Actions to approve pull requests
verify founder/admin recovery exists for founder-operated repositories unless an independent reviewer path is verified end-to-end
preserve CI, security, provenance, and signature gates during recovery
verify platform rules are derived from canonical JPV policy and are not the sole representation of governance authority
